_how_to_add: Only a parent's own words, used with their yes to being quoted on the site. Never write, reword or combine quotes; check the text against the recording or the parent's approved wording, not an AI summary of the session.

text: their words, trimmed only (an ellipsis where you cut). Changing he/she to 'my child' to anonymize is fine. name: optional, first name only. label: who this is and how they worked with Matthew (e.g. 'Parent of a toddler, in-home coaching'), so no one takes it for a review of the video classes.

pages: where it shows: home, pricing, infant, toddlerhood, preschool, family (up to 4 per page, in file order). consent: where and when the parent said yes. It is not published; this file is not deployed.
Then run: node scripts/build-quotes.mjs and commit. CI fails if the pages and this file disagree (node scripts/build-quotes.mjs --check).
One quote per family. Never add Review or Rating structured data for these.

quotes.text: Before, my toddler would just take off in parking lots. But using the boundaries we practiced, calmly explaining, ‘You’re going to hold my hand and we’re going to walk, we’re not running here,’ my child was completely fine with it. I definitely see improvement in how my child understands expectations and responds to direction.
quotes.label: Parent of a toddler, in-home coaching
